EmailTemplate.description: Standard template which explains how to obtain a SF user account with a Case Management role.
EmailTemplate.name: ASU SFS | Case Mgmt | How to gain access
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
In order to gain access to Salesforce, you will need to complete two training courses: FERPA and Salesforce Managing Cases for Departments. They can be found on the UTO Training website https://sites.google.com/a/asu.edu/utotraining/ or by searching Blackboard on My ASU https://webapp4.asu.edu/myasu/. Let me know if you have any difficulty finding the training courses.
Once your training is complete, you will request the Salesforce Case Management role. Instructions how to do this can be found at the following article: How to Request Access to Salesforce https://asu.service-now.com/ess/kb_view.do?sysparm_article=KB0012611. Please let me know if you have any further questions about this request.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
ASU Salesforce Support USB | University Technology Office 1551 S. Rural Rd. Tempe, AZ 85281 salesforce.support@asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
